headline: Fisherman's Row Reawakens as Northern Attrition Remains Severe
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the lull on Fisherman's Row proved short-lived as island fighting reawakened, registering three base transitions within the last two hours and an influx of fresh recruits across disputed strongpoints including Eidolo and Black Well. In Mooring County, combat intensified with casualty rates climbing rapidly, marking several base transfers before dawn as Colonial forces retain two footholds against ten Warden bastions. Callahan's Passage and the Weathered Expanse remain the war's primary cauldrons of attrition; while strategic line shifts halted over the past two hours, both sectors absorbed thousands of casualties, with Callahan's Passage showing fresh acceleration in local casualty tallies. Conversely, the tempest on the Stlican Shelf and in the Linn of Mercy has cooled markedly, with zero base exchanges recorded in the latest two-hour window and casualty rates tapering off. Palantine Berm and Stonecradle have likewise settled into quiet standoff postures, leaving the central-northern corridor and the western archipelago as the principal active theaters.
